topic.title: Signing Up to an Organization
topic.shortdesc: Learn how to join an organization by using an invitation link or the organization ID.

body.p: If you want to join an organization, you will usually receive an invitation. In that case, follow the invitation link to sign up for that organization.
If you do not have an invitation, you need to know the organization ID. Start from the Cloud main page:
Then use the I know my organization ID action and follow the steps to complete the sign-up process.
During this process, you will be asked to:

ul.li: Provide the Organization ID. This identifier will be used to generate the organization URL.

Sign up within the organization. If you were already invited, a platform user role will be assigned to you. Otherwise, you can request that an organization administrator assign you a platform user role.
